interview.name: Noah
interview.answer: The repair drive is still on for Saturday, but the location isn't specified in the notes.

reflections: Noah is cooperative but initially unclear on logistics; he responds well when others restate the request concretely.
Vik is acting as the organizer who clarifies the plan and delegates outreach tasks.
Bo also engages constructively and mirrors the same support role by helping spread the word and gather supplies.
Noah is coordinating practical support by spreading the word, checking for broken items, and gathering tools and spare parts.
Bo and Vik are reinforcing the same repair-drive plan by helping advertise needs and timing, showing shared coordination.
Opal is managing logistics and updates, while the group is keeping communication tight and responsive.
Noah is the main coordinator and tends to keep the repair drive moving by asking around, sharing updates, and tracking materials.
Hana is deferring specifics until the final list is confirmed, so others are waiting on her for concrete details like volunteers, tools, and spare parts.
Mina is willing to help once the time and place are set, and Noah benefits from more explicit reminders because the details are still fuzzy.
Noah is coordinating the repair drive but is unsure about details and relies on others to remind him.
Mina is responsive and proactive, offering to spread the word and bring broken items.
Faye appears to be organizing logistics and will share task assignments once the list is checked.
Noah is dependable and willing to coordinate follow-through, but he sometimes needs reminders or confirmation on details.
The repair drive relies on a small group of people who respond positively to clear, specific asks about spreading the word and bringing items.
Faye and Mina act as organizers who keep the effort moving by confirming timing, jobs, and next steps.
